items.hook: Malcolm Wells was an American architect who is regarded as "the father of modern earth-sheltered architecture." Wells lived on Cape Cod, Massachusetts in a modern earth-sheltered building of his own design.
items.body: Wells was also a writer, illustrator, draftsman, lecturer, cartoonist, columnist, and solar energy consultant. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: In the spring and summer of 1647, an "epidemical sickness" prevailed throughout the New England Colonies and along the coast of English America.
items.body: Considered the first documented influenza epidemic in North America, the outbreak is said to have spread all the way to the West Indies, where significant mortality was reported. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Rasmus Paludan is a Danish-Swedish politician and lawyer, who is the founder and leader of the far-right, nationalist, Danish political party Stram Kurs.
items.body: Paludan has become known for his extremist views, including that Islam should be banned and that immigrants of non-Western background should be deported from Denmark. One of those things you can't un-know.
